title: Kauders v. Uber Technologies — opening only
shortTitle: Kauders v. Uber Technologies — opening only
summary: The last assigned page begins a dispute concerning blind riders, service refusals, and an arbitration clause.
notes: The opening reports registration through an app, an order compelling arbitration, and an arbitration result. The opinion continues beyond p. 304. Its eventual holding and interface analysis have not been imported into the class 9 brief set. The chapter’s introduction asks readers to compare notice and manifested consent in later online cases.
